BIOL 1610.title: College Biology I
BIOL 1610.precoreqText: ACT (or equivalent) composite score of 21+, or ENGH 1005 or ENGL1010 (or higher); BIOL 1615

CHEM 1110.title: Elementary Chemistry for the Health Sciences
CHEM 1110.precoreqText: MAT 1010 or MAT 2015 or STAT 1040 or STAT 1045 , or a placement score into MATH 1050 or higher.

CHEM 1210.title: Principles of Chemistry I
CHEM 1210.prereqText: MATH 1080 , MATH 1050 , MATH 1055 or any higher MATH course with a C- or better, or appropriate placement scores for MATH 1060 or higher. Also, it is highly recommended to have prior chemistry experience in high school or in CHEM 1010

CHEM 1220.title: Principles of Chemistry II
CHEM 1220.prereqText: CHEM 1210 with a grade of C- or higher

ENGL 1010.title: Introduction to Academic Writing
ENGL 1010.prereqText: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years.
prereqWords: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years

ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H with a grade of C- or higher, or ENGH 1005 with a grade of C or higher.

EXSC 2500.title: Sports Medicine
EXSC 2500.prereqText: EXSC Majors: ZOOL 2320 (or 2320H), ZOOL 2325 (or 2320L), all with a C- or higher and ( MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 ). PETE and REC Majors: ZOOL 1090 .
EXSC 2500.precoreqText: ZOOL 2420 (or 2420H), ZOOL 2425 (or 2420L), EXSC 2700G all with a C- or higher and ( MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 ). PETE Majors: PETE 2700 with a C- or higher and ( MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 ). REC Majors: REC 2200 .

prereqWords: all with a C- or higher
